using SkiaSharp;
using VolleyDraft.Api.Services;
using VolleyDraft.Api.Services.Posters;
using Xunit;

namespace VolleyDraft.Api.Tests;

public sealed class Poster4ClashPreviewTempTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Render_clash_night_preview()
    {
        static TeamCardTeam Team(string name, string captain, double score, params string[] names) =>
            new(name, captain, score, names.Select((player, index) => new TeamCardSlot(
                player,
                [new TeamCardPlayer(player, IsCaptain: index == 0)],
                index == 0)).ToList());

        var teams = new[]
        {
            Team("AURORA", "MINH", 7.8, "MINH", "TÙNG", "TO AN", "KHANG", "NAM", "HUY"),
            Team("PHANTOM", "PHÚC", 8.1, "PHÚC", "LONG", "DUY", "BẢO", "KIÊN", "TUẤN"),
            Team("TITAN", "QUÂN", 7.9, "QUÂN", "SƠN", "ĐỨC", "THẮNG", "HẢI", "HOÀNG")
        };

        var png = MonolithBroadcastPosterRenderer.Render(
            "CHỦ NHẬT • MAIN EVENT",
            new DateTimeOffset(2026, 8, 16, 19, 30, 0, TimeSpan.FromHours(7)),
            "RIVERSIDE VOLLEYBALL COURT",
            teams);

        using var bitmap = SKBitmap.Decode(png);
        Assert.NotNull(bitmap);
        Assert.Equal(1440, bitmap!.Width);
        Assert.Equal(1800, bitmap.Height);
        Assert.True(png.Length > 100_000);

        var output = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("POSTER4_PREVIEW_PATH");
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(output))
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(output)!);
            File.WriteAllBytes(output, png);
        }
    }
}
